placements.why: This envelope's content is a test artifact whose whole purpose is verification: reproducing a named prod failure pattern and checking the fix holds under defined criteria. No strata exists yet in this repo, and nothing in the illustrative category set is closer than a verification/proof-of-behavior category — this is the organizational home for test-and-validate content going forward, not just this one test.
placements.title: Proof as verification that a system behaves as claimed
placements.frame: What production failure or claim is being independently reproduced and checked here, and what does the check settle?

placements.title: Derive-id tests must reproduce real prod failure patterns and hold crash-safety as an invariant
placements.frame: What production failure pattern is this test reproducing, and what invariant (no crash, valid output) must survive that reproduction?
placements.why: src-1 names the reproduction target (the ## heading with no id field, prod's exact missing-id pattern) and src-2 states the acceptance criteria reproduction must clear (no crash, valid slug). Together they name a recurring subject — every derive-id test going forward will be judged by whether it reproduces a known failure class and enforces this same non-crash/valid-output invariant — not a one-time fact about a single test run, so it clears the narrative grain test. Nothing in the (empty) existing structure covers this; minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata since testing/verification content is that category's exact fit.
